flows.requirement: OPEN chat create, reload and idempotent replay
flows.testName: P10-E2E-001 OPEN chat creates with UUID, reloads and idempotent replay does not duplicate
flows.resolution: Canonical REST creation, reload and stable clientMessageId retry are connected.

flows.requirement: own edit, own soft-delete, tombstone and ownership controls
flows.testName: P10-E2E-002 own edit/delete works, manager has no override and tombstone replaces content
flows.resolution: Capability-gated edit/delete use Message If-Match and preserve content-free tombstones.

flows.requirement: CLOSED chat stays writable from backend capability
flows.testName: P10-E2E-003 CLOSED ticket remains read-only for workflow but writable in chat
flows.resolution: Composer follows capabilities.canWriteChat independently of workflow read-only state.

flows.requirement: external Board Transfer ID opens canonical Ticket chat
flows.testName: P10-E2E-004 external Transfer row opens Message API with Ticket ID, never Transfer ID
flows.resolution: TicketModal passes canonical ticketId to Chat while Board state retains Transfer ID.

flows.requirement: A-B-C continuity, previous Room and pending participants
flows.testName: P10-E2E-005 A-B-C chat is continuous for previous Room, current source and pending destination
flows.resolution: All reads and writes address one backend Message stream owned by the Ticket.

flows.testName: P10-E2E-006 cursor pagination prepends older messages, preserves anchor and keeps tombstones
flows.resolution: Opaque cursors, version-aware merge and measured scroll anchoring were added.

flows.requirement: two-client realtime create, edit and delete invalidation
flows.testName: P10-E2E-007 two clients synchronize create, edit and soft-delete through scoped invalidation
flows.resolution: Chat extends the existing authenticated Socket singleton and refreshes through REST.

flows.testName: P10-E2E-008 stale edit shows real version conflict, server truth and preserves draft for retry
flows.resolution: Message ETag conflicts refresh server truth without discarding the local draft.

flows.requirement: concurrent edit/delete resolves to server tombstone
flows.testName: P10-E2E-009 concurrent edit/delete has one winner and final tombstone cannot show edited content
flows.resolution: Version-aware merging converges to the latest content-free server tombstone.

flows.requirement: Ticket switch race rejects late responses
flows.testName: P10-E2E-010 delayed Ticket A response cannot overwrite Ticket B chat state
flows.resolution: Abort signals and request generations isolate every Ticket switch.

flows.requirement: Socket failure keeps REST writes available and reconnect refreshes
flows.testName: P10-E2E-011 Socket interruption keeps history and REST writes available, then reconnect refreshes once
flows.resolution: REST remains the only write path; reconnect invalidations are coalesced and cleaned up.

flows.requirement: access revocation clears active unauthorized content
flows.testName: P10-E2E-012 membership revocation removes active access and cached content from the reopened chat
flows.resolution: Authorization errors fail closed and clear active Message state.

flows.requirement: plain-text rendering, error states and no attachment UI
flows.testName: P10-E2E-013 plain text is escaped, mixed direction is readable and no attachment control exists
flows.resolution: React text rendering and a text-only composer preserve safety and Phase boundaries.
